---
name: check-spelling
description: Find and fix likely spelling mistakes in documentation, comments, and user-facing text while leaving code symbols and accepted names alone.
---

# Check Spelling

Use this skill when asked to review spelling.

1. Focus on docs, comments, UI copy, API messages, and tests that assert user-facing text.
2. Do not change identifiers, filenames, URLs, proper nouns, product names, or domain terms unless the repo clearly uses a different spelling.
3. Prefer the smallest edit that fixes the typo without changing tone or meaning.
4. If scope is unclear, check changed files first, then nearby markdown and text files.
5. Report uncertain terms instead of silently “fixing” them.
